t: This is 37 Foley Street, an eighteenth-century terraced house and shop in Fitzrovia. It's a modest-looking building with a famous former resident. The painter Henry Fuseli lived here from 1788 to 1803. Fuseli was born in Switzerland, and spent much of his career in Britain as a painter, draughtsman and writer on art. So when you pass this front door, you're looking at where he lived for fifteen years.
